name: models
description: Discover which LLM providers and models are ready on this venue for your identity. Load before selecting or overriding an agent's llmOperation/model.

content.inline:
## Models
Call `v/ops/langchain/models` with `{provider?}`. It walks `v/models/` and returns providers with `ready`, a catalog-path `default`, path-valued `recommended`, compatible id-valued `models`, and detailed `entries` whose `op` is directly invocable.

Reading the answer:
- `ready` is caller-relative. For hosted providers it means your secret store or the venue environment supplies `keySecret`; the value is never shown. For Ollama it means the configured server is reachable; `installedModels` is its live set.
- Prefer an entry's model operation directly: `{llmOperation: <entry.op>}`. The preset supplies its model id and profile.
- Caller `model`, `url` and `apiKey` values still override preset defaults. Restrictions belong in capability gates.
- Legacy `{llmOperation: <provider.op>, model: <id>}` remains supported.
- Usually omit `apiKey`; set `apiKey: "s/<name>"` only to override the provider's secret binding.

The built-in venue fallback is `v/models/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`. Templates are provider-neutral, so an explicit later model or provider layer wins.
